name: browser-use
headline: Pomodoro: Enhance Productivity with AI Automation
short_description: Pomodoro timer skill that remembers, learns, and improves over time. Operations teams use it to manage time blocks. Connects to CLI, SKILL.md, and a database for persistent state management.
author: jakedahn

sections.overview: The Pomodoro skill is a reference implementation of the System Skill Pattern designed for building Claude Skills that can remember, learn, and improve over time. This skill features a command-line interface (CLI) and a comprehensive SKILL.md documentation alongside a database, all demonstrated through a Pomodoro timer. By leveraging this skill, users can automate their productivity workflows, allowing for more efficient time management and task execution. One of the key benefits of the Pomodoro skill is its ability to enhance productivity by structuring work into focused intervals, typically 25 minutes, followed by short breaks. While the exact time savings are not quantified, the systematic approach to task management can lead to significant improvements in focus and efficiency. This skill is particularly beneficial for developers, product managers, and AI practitioners who often juggle multiple tasks and need a reliable method to maintain productivity without burnout. The Pomodoro skill is suitable for professionals across various roles, especially those involved in software development and project management. It can be integrated into daily workflows to help maintain concentration and manage time effectively. For instance, a developer might use the Pomodoro timer to break down coding tasks into manageable intervals, while a product manager could apply it to streamline meetings and planning sessions. By implementing this skill, teams can foster a culture of productivity and continuous improvement. With an intermediate implementation difficulty and an estimated setup time of around 30 minutes, the Pomodoro skill requires basic familiarity with command-line tools and workflow automation. As organizations increasingly adopt AI-first strategies, integrating such automation skills into daily operations can significantly enhance overall efficiency. The Pomodoro skill exemplifies how AI automation can transform traditional productivity methods into a more adaptive and intelligent approach.
sections.setup:
No install command available. Check the GitHub repository for manual installation instructions.
`git clone https://github.com/jakedahn/pomodoro`
sections.usage:
```
Act as a Pomodoro timer for my workday. I'm working on [PROJECT] for [COMPANY] in the [INDUSTRY] sector. I need to break my work into 25-minute focused sessions with 5-minute breaks. Remember my previous sessions and suggest improvements. Connect to my CLI, SKILL.md, and database for persistent state management.
```
